violated_contract: A mobile surface that can animate continuously (Home's live dot while a capture is live, an indeterminate processing bar) must not hand SchedulerBinding an idle-priority task: the default scheduling strategy declines it while any ticker runs, and the scheduler re-arms a zero-delay timer every event-loop turn until the animation stops, spinning the UI isolate (INV-PERF-1).
canonical_prevention: Defer off-frame work with Timer.run, a Future or a post-frame callback, never SchedulerBinding.scheduleTask below Priority.animation from a surface that can animate. Guard by pumping the real animating surface, replacing the binding's schedulingStrategy with a counter that fails past a small bound, and checking the deferred work still lands.
